title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E05 — The Ghost on the Radio
When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E02 — Alien Evidence: The Holy Grail
When a powerful radio beam originating from deep space is detected by experts on Earth, some suspect it's hard evidence of extraterrestrial life; new investigations into this shocking signal might reveal the truth.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E01 — Curse of the Lost Cosmonaut
When two experts build their own radio-listening station to intercept the secret communications of American and Soviet astronauts, they capture traces of a haunting voice that may be a lost Russian cosmonaut.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E07 — Omen of the Pharaoh's Wail
Experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate a mysterious phenomenon at the tomb of a 3,000-year-old Egyptian pharaoh.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E06 — To Catch a UFO
When a U.S. Air Force intercept aircraft chases after a UFO, it vanishes forever without a trace; a new investigation tries to uncover what caused this mysterious disappearance.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E05 — Train Track Terror
Security cameras capture a baby stroller pushed by a mysterious force across a London subway platform and crash onto the tracks; experts investigate and uncover a disturbing history of paranormal incidents surrounding London's subway system.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E04 — Tsunami of Fire
A security camera captures panic in Lima, Peru, as a wave of fire chases terrified citizens down a city street claiming 30 lives; experts uncover reports of a disastrous fuel tanker accident with an inadequate and fatal safety response.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S06 E03 — Curse of Zombie Island
A village mourner at an Indonesian funeral films a dead man's hand waving through the glass window of a coffin; experts investigate and uncover powerful local priests and the practice of black magic rituals to reanimate corpses back from the dead.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E09 — Alien in Paradise
A bizarre, tentacled black mass emerges from the seas on an island in the Caribbean, and on-lookers are horrified as it writhes ashore; experts use cutting-edge tech to investigate the origin of this alien invader.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E07 — Possessed by an Alien
When footage reveals a man's leg taking on a life of its own, it appears that something alien is trying to burst free; cutting-edge science investigates what explains this strange possession, and what it takes to exorcise the invader inside.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E03 — Haunted and Hunted
A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years; a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky; a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.

description:
S01 E02 — Alien Inside Me
Tormented by childhood memories of abduction, a woman discovers an implant in her body; a sailor captures lights over the Pacific Ocean that he believes are alien craft, and a couple finds unusual footprints in the woods.

The Assassination Sphere
A minuscule metal sphere containing two microscopic holes could be the smallest murder weapon in history; experts explore how this tiny object is linked to one of the most bizarre true crime cases of the 20th century.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Dixon Relics
A stone sphere, a hook and five fragments of wood are the only objects ever discovered inside the Great Pyramid of Giza; experts investigate if they can explain the mysteries behind the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E09 — Birth of the Monster Black Holes
New discoveries reveal an astonishing supermassive black hole that was born during the earliest days of the cosmos, and finding out how this giant grew so large so quickly may help to explain the very formation of the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E03 — Secrets of the Sun
A brand-new NASA mission to the sun reveals cutting-edge discoveries about Earth's star; as the Parker Solar Probe dives through the sun's atmosphere, its findings challenge everything known about this strange place.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E06 — When NASA Met Jupiter
NASA's Juno spacecraft is part of a cutting-edge mission to explore the mysteries of Jupiter; as this mighty probe is pummeled with deadly radiation, it gathers new data that could change everything we know about the solar system's biggest planet.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E08 — Migration of the Monsters
In order to build a colossal airplane, the crew needs to gather parts from around the world; three dump trucks need to be shipped.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E06 — Billion-Dollar Superbuild
A nearly 2 billion dollar bridge is being built, and Mega Shippers need to lift portions of the bridge 180 feet above a river; in Florida, $150 million-worth of yachts need to be moved without incident.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E05 — Freight of Fire
In Louisiana, tons of biofuel is destined for a power plant across the Atlantic; a ship loader dangles in the sky; a faulty radio could squash the operation.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E03 — Ultimate Cruise Ship
Shippers in Virginia have a few hours to move 5,700 tons of cargo onto a barge, but a thunderstorm threatens the chances of completing the task; one of the world's largest cruise ships needs to restock.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E02 — Mission: Super Yacht
A yacht crosses the Atlantic Ocean during hurricane season; a crew needs to move a 20-ton aircraft cabin trainer to Africa.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
S01 E01 — Grand Ship Auto
$34 million worth of cars must be shipped across the Atlantic; nuclear parts needing to be shipped present a unique set of problems.

title: Mega Shippers
description:
Championship Cargo
A helicopter has just come off the production line and shipping it across the Atlantic in immaculate condition presents a unique set of challenges; a rally car must be moved across a few countries in a matter of days.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E07 — Oklahoma Freeway Free-fall
A deadly tragedy on a freeway in Oklahoma sends one of the state's busiest bridges collapsing into the Arkansas River below; expert engineers investigate how a tugboat striking a reinforced concrete pier could cause such a catastrophic disaster.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E08 — Kansas City Skywalk Disaster
When an indoor hotel walkway collapses in Kansas City, Mo., it becomes the most deadly engineering disaster in U.S. history; experts investigate and uncover evidence of a catastrophic design change in the support system construction.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E10 — Pittsburgh Landslide
A vital hillside highway in Pennsylvania is destroyed in just minutes after a catastrophic landslide rocks a community; engineers investigate and uncover undetected geological issues with an increased and unstable traffic load.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S05 E01 — San Francisco Freeway Fire
Catastrophe strikes as one of America's most vital freeway intersections erupts in flames and completely collapses in San Francisco; experts use the latest science to investigate how an overturned tanker truck spawned a devastating inferno.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S05 E02 — Arizona Railroad Inferno
A devastating railroad inferno takes down a vital route on a historic river crossing in Arizona; using the latest cutting-edge technology, experts investigate the remaining incinerated evidence to determine what caused such a disastrous derailment.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S04 E09 — Suez Canal Catastrophe
A shipping catastrophe occurs when a massive container vessel runs aground and completely blocks one of the most vital trade routes on the planet; experts investigate and uncover critical wind conditions and potential navigational errors.

description:
The Jericho Head
In 1953, a team of archaeologists uncovers a bizarre, plastered human skull in the ancient city of Jericho; experts investigate the mysterious purpose and identity behind this 9,000-year-old clay-covered artifact.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Standard of Ur
Discovered in the ruins of the ancient city of Ur, a mysterious wooden box adorned with an elaborate mosaic continues to mystify archaeologists today; experts explore the meaning behind its intricate and enigmatic images.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E04 — Aliens of the Microcosmos
The hidden kingdom of microscopic alien organisms shapes the universe as much as galaxies, stars, and planets; new discoveries reveal how bacteria, viruses and other microorganisms built life on Earth and influence humanity's future in the cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E11 — Mystery of Alien Worlds
An explosion in the discovery of exoplanets is challenging everything we know about our universe; experts use cutting-edge astronomy to investigate these mysterious alien worlds and how they defy the laws of physics.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E02 — NASA's Journey to Mars
NASA plans to send humans to Mars within just 15 years, but to reach this next frontier of space exploration, experts must discover new technology and cutting-edge science that protects astronauts from the Red Planet's deadliest killers.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E03 — Knights Templar in America
New evidence suggests the Knights Templar fled Europe and rebuilt their warrior order in the Americas a century before Christopher Columbus; experts use technology to investigate long-lost relics to see if they confirm this game-changing theory.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E07 — Egypt's Land of the Gods
New evidence from one of the world's oldest maps offers clues to a long-lost civilization of untold treasure, and this cutting-edge expedition might finally prove that this mysterious kingdom is the ancestral home of the ancient Egyptians.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E04 — Killing Meriwether Lewis
Meriwether Lewis was the man who teamed with William Clark to map the lands west of the Mississippi, but he died in mysterious circumstances; experts reveal a vast conspiracy that could prove that one of America's greatest explorers was murdered.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E01 — Ghost Ship of the Damned
Using a long-lost treasure map purporting to show the whereabouts of a missing ship buried with gold and silver in the California desert, a team of experts uses the new evidence to get closer to a game-changing discovery.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E08 — Finding the Fountain of Youth
The legend of the Fountain of Youth might finally be explained by hidden messages encoded in a 500-year-old map, and using cutting-edge archaeological methods, experts explore forgotten caves and perilous waters to reveal long-lost secrets.

title: Unexplained and Unexplored
description:
S01 E06 — Mystery of the American Maya
New evidence suggests the Mayan empire may have reestablished themselves in America; using high-tech mapping systems, Justin and Emiliano scan the Florida landscape as they search for ancient canoes and flat-topped pyramids.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E06 — Man Made Disasters
As technology advances, manmade accidents have become as destructive as some natural disasters; a look at recent catastrophes.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E01 — Megafloods
When water unleashes its rage upon the planet, it becomes the ultimate bringer of death; whether it's from rain washing over the ground, rivers bursting their banks, or failed efforts to stem the flow, flooding is as inevitable as it is unstoppable.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E04 — Earthquakes
Earthquakes occur when tectonic plates suddenly shift and shock waves shake the Earth's surface; they occur along fault lines -- the most active being the Ring of Fire in the Pacific Ocean and the San Andreas Fault on the American West Coast.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E03 — Hurricanes, Typhoons, Cyclones
Hurricanes, typhoons and cyclones are all the same thing with different names, but what they also have in common is their destructive power.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E02 — Construction Disasters
Dams control water supply and generate power, but cities can be submerged in minutes if something goes wrong; bridges and tunnels make hard-to-reach places easily accessible, but when they unexpectedly fail, the results can be disastrous.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E07 — Volcanoes
Volcanoes created more than 80% of our planet's surface, but explosive eruptions can be deadly; a journey under the earth to discover why volcanoes are so dangerous.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E05 — Tornadoes
Tornadoes are violent, rotating columns of air that can level buildings, their unpredictability makes them even more destructive; a look at how tornadoes form and if they can be stopped.

description:
The Macabre Hat of Teeth
A museum in South London contains a disturbing tattered hat made of brown felt and decorated with more than 80 human teeth; using the latest imaging technology, experts investigate to uncover the macabre origins of this mysterious Victorian-era cap.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Mamari Tablet
An ancient tablet discovered on the remote reaches of Easter Island is etched in a mysterious glyph system that has yet to be deciphered; experts use cutting-edge tech to determine if this wooden relic could be the key to a lost civilization.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E07 — The Next Supernova
The galaxy is full of stars ready to explode into supernovas, a stellar detonation powerful enough to destroy all life on Earth; it's an event that hasn't occurred in 400 years, and the search is on to locate which star may be next.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E07 — Edge of the Universe
We don't yet know where the edge of the universe is or what happens there; but thanks to cutting-edge technology and new discoveries, experts might finally reveal the secrets of the phenomena.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E01 — Terror of Nazi Propaganda
After seizing power in 1933, Adolf Hitler began systematically transforming a peaceful German population into a ruthless war machine; experts investigate the innovative methods used by the Nazis to indoctrinate and control the will of its citizens.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E03 — Mary Magdalene Enigma
Mary Magdalene played a pivotal role in early Christianity and witnessed the execution and resurrection of Jesus Christ; experts investigate the truth behind her mysterious disappearance and embark on a quest to locate her undiscovered remains.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E04 — Secrets of Gobekli Tepe
The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe is the oldest building complex ever discovered and continues to baffle archaeologists; experts investigate new theories behind its construction as a possible commemoration to a cataclysmic event.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E06 — Secrets of the Crucifixion
Uncover the true stories surrounding great treasures, long-held conspiracy theories, ancient relics and lost civilizations as experts analyze and investigate history's most astonishing mysteries.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E02 — The Devil's Bible
"The Codex Gigas," also known as the "Devil's Bible," is a giant medieval tome that has evoked fear for centuries and is believed to contain a malevolent power; experts investigate its legendary secrets and uncover the mystery behind its author.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E05 — Mystery of the Hypogeum
A subterranean Neolithic temple discovered on the island of Malta contains the skeletal remains of thousands of humans; experts use forensic archaeology to investigate elongated skulls that may unlock the secrets of an advanced, lost civilization.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E03 — Indiana's War Factory
Satellite images capture a large compound of abandoned structures that are overgrown with vegetation in Indiana; experts investigate and uncover a derelict WWII munitions factory that played a crucial role in US military history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E04 — Turkey's Lost Terror Dome
Aerial drone imaging captures a circular man-made structure that appears to be centuries-old in the remote forests of Aydin, Turkey; experts investigate a lost ancient amphitheater with a history steeped in gladiatorial bloodshed.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E05 — Blood Feud of Gresham Castle
Satellite images capture a mysterious fortification concealed beneath a patch of woodland in the remote stretches of Norfolk, England; experts investigate rival royal families and a lost castle that was destroyed during a medieval blood feud.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E06 — The Boneyard of Arizona
Satellite images capture miles of aircraft precisely arranged in the vast Arizona desert; experts investigate the largest aircraft storage facility on Earth and the rotting remains of a defining moment in Cold War history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E07 — Nevada's Mystery Marking
Satellite images capture an enormous X shape mysteriously carved with precision in the remote Nevada desert; experts investigate a military emergency landing field linked to one of the most astonishing test programs in aviation history.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E08 — Ghost Ship of Ireland
A ghost ship appears overnight on the shores of Ireland; it may help shed light on the fate of vessels claimed by the most notorious patch of ocean on earth.
